description: This file defines the 'ConnectionIdInvalidException' class, a custom exception thrown when a connection ID is invalid. It includes nested builder class for constructing instances, methods for creating instances from JSON, and handles exception details specific to invalid connection IDs within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity module.

classes.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating an invalid ConnectionId, extends DittoRuntimeException, immutable, with JSON serialization support, including builder pattern for construction.

classes.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe mutable builder class for constructing instances of ConnectionIdInvalidException, supports fluent API.

methods.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for ConnectionIdInvalidException with optional ID to be included in the message.

methods.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionIdInvalidException from a JSON object and headers, utilizing the inherited fromJson method.

methods.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with updated headers, preserving other exception details.

methods.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException.Builder.doBuild
methods.description: Internal method to create a ConnectionIdInvalidException with provided details.
